headline: Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle Erupt Under Heavy Frontline Fire
war_summary: Combat has sharply pivoted along the eastern line over the past three hours, where Stlican Shelf suddenly erupted into five base turnovers concentrated at Briar, expanding Colonial holdings to seven strategic centers against two Warden bastions. Callahan's Passage continues to grind under ferocious pressure, tallying over fifteen hundred casualties in two hours as Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage change hands once more. In Weathered Expanse, relentless crossfire has expanded the desolate no-man's-land, reducing another strategic center to rubble to leave four positions completely destroyed while Colonials hold five. Stonecradle has similarly reignited with five rapid base transitions across The Reach and Trammel Pool, enabling Warden forces to reclaim ground and secure a second redoubt within the contested sector. Meanwhile, the tempestuous western front in Nevish Line has cooled abruptly, recording no base shifts during the past two hours following earlier turmoil, while Palantine Berm and Mooring County remain firmly stabilized under complete Warden administration.
